AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-08-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: P. Dias, CSR: Dave Davenport
Petitioner: Maria M. Saavedra, present in pro per with Spanish Interpreter: Juan Ramirez.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Ana Luisa Gonzalez.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-27-2007 Amended
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patricia VanSteenberge.
Petitioner: Maria Saavedra, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Ana Luisa Saavedra.
Ana Saavedra is also serve a Spanish Interpreter for her mother,
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and no proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to May 8, 2007, at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date or to apply for an Order dispensing with notice.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
